install: a launcher at {tooldir}/bin/aibom-generator that runs `python -m src.cli` from the clone
unmeasured: Takes a Hugging Face model ID, not a directory, and has no offline input. huggingface.co was unreachable, so it wrote a placeholder BOM. Its score is a floor, not a measurement of its model-card extraction.
notes: Run with one model ID from the corpus; the project directory is not an input this tool accepts.
